subject: Dispute: May tiered usage spike — credit schedule proposal
messages:
From: Atlas Health <billing@atlashealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Mullins <sara@atlashealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice charge spike — request for adjustment and VAT treatment

Hi Jonas,

We flagged a large overage on invoice #INV-0427 (attached) that pushed us into the next usage tier for the month of April. The spike was driven by a one-week onboarding test run with a third-party partner; we communicated the test activity ahead of time but it looks like it was billed at normal production rates.

Can you confirm:
- Whether those onboarding tokens can be excluded or reclassified so we are billed at the previous tier rate for April?
- How you will treat VAT on any credit (credit note vs. VAT refund).

We need a timeline for resolution and any supporting evidence (usage export + invoice/redline) for our accounting team. Attaching invoice_0427.pdf for reference.

Thanks,
Sara Mullins
Billing Manager, Atlas Health
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Atlas Health <billing@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice charge spike — request for adjustment and VAT treatment

Hi Sara — thanks for flagging this and for attaching the invoice. I’ve looped in Laura (finance) and Ben (account ops) so we can reconcile usage and confirm VAT handling.

Quick plan:
- We’ll pull the detailed usage export for April and identify any sessions marked as onboarding/test.
- If those sessions are confirmed as non-production activity, we can propose a retroactive tier reclassification and issue a credit.
- Laura will advise on VAT treatment (credit note vs. refund).

Can you send the usage export you referenced and any internal notes that mark the test period (timestamps or partner identifiers) so we can match? If it helps, I can schedule a 30-minute call early next week to walk through the logs.

Provisional note: pending reconciliation, I can propose a provisional goodwill credit to avoid interrupting your cash flow; final number will depend on the usage reconciliation.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127
From: Atlas Health <billing@atlashealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Mullins <sara@atlashealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice charge spike — request for adjustment and VAT treatment

Jonas — attaching the usage export and a brief note from our integration lead that marks the onboarding window (see usage_export_may.csv). The onboarding flag is present in the partner_id column for rows dated 2027-04-11 to 2027-04-18.

We’d like the credit to cover:
- The overage amount charged due to tier jump (we calculate £4,500 GBP)
- Applicable VAT on that credit (we believe VAT was charged at 20% on the invoice line, so please confirm how you’ll return VAT).

Timeline: ideally resolved before month-end so we can close our books.

Thanks,
Sara

Attachments: invoice_0427.pdf, usage_export_may.csv
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice charge spike — request for adjustment and VAT treatment

FW: customer provided usage_export_may.csv that flags partner_id=onboarding for 2027-04-11 -> 04-18. Sara is asking we: 1) reclass the usage so Atlas is billed at previous tier; 2) return VAT on the credit.

Short ask: can finance approve a provisional credit of $5,200 USD (approx £4,500 GBP) as a goodwill + retro-proration pending final reconciliation? Proposed split: $4,500 service credit + $700 VAT adjustment (we can inverse-charge if needed or issue a VAT credit note). If approved, I’ll send the customer a settlement memo and coordinate a credit memo to be generated (DocuSign if needed).

Notes and attachments: they attached invoice_0427.pdf and the usage_export_may.csv. I haven’t shared the credit draft yet.

Thanks — need sign-off to avoid delaying their month-end close.

Best,
Jonas

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice charge spike — request for adjustment and VAT treatment

Jonas — reviewed the export and the rough numbers. Finance approves a provisional customer-facing settlement as follows:

- Service credit: $4,500 USD (goodwill + retro-proration)
- VAT component: $700 USD (we will issue a VAT credit note; for UK VAT we can issue a credit rather than a cash refund unless customer requests otherwise)

Action items:
1) Ben: please draft a credit memo (credit-memo-draft.pdf) and prepare DocuSign routing to Atlas billing contact.
2) Jonas: confirm the exact invoice number to offset and obtain customer sign-off on settlement memo.
3) I’ll validate the $4,500 number against usage logs and sign the final credit note once Ben’s draft is ready.

We should also confirm currency conversions on the final memo (customer quoted GBP). For the customer-facing message, state that credit will appear as a line-item on next invoice; VAT credit note will be issued electronically within 10 business days after the credit memo is signed.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: credit-memo-draft.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Atlas Health <billing@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Settlement: provisional credit & VAT credit note for INV-0427

Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the usage export. Per our reconciliation and finance approval (cc Laura and Ben), here is the proposed settlement:

- Service credit: $4,500 USD applied as a credit line against invoice INV-0427; will show on your next invoice as "Service credit - retroactive tier reclassification".
- VAT handling: a VAT credit note for $700 USD will be issued electronically once the credit memo is signed; if you prefer a cash refund please indicate and we will route through refunds team (may take up to 30 days).
- Timeline: credit applied to next invoice (June billing cycle). VAT credit note issued within 10 business days after DocuSign execution.

I’ve attached a short settlement-memo.pdf summarizing the reconciliation. Ben will send the DocuSign credit memo (credit-memo-draft.pdf) to your billing address; please review and sign so we can finalize.

If you’d like a quick call to confirm, I’m available Wednesday morning.

Appreciate you working with us on this — we’ll make sure this is resolved before month-end.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127
